boundary: Current publication claims are source-reviewed. TierListBase does not claim direct personal live testing of any unit, trait, equipment interaction or evolution. Passing source review means a record's facts were checked; it does not mean the record is a publisher placement. Only the Overall view is reconcilable against a published tier list, because it uses that source's five-level scale. The DPS, Utility, Support and Crowd Control sub-grades add an S+ level the source never publishes, so those sub-grades are TierListBase editorial for every unit.
